INPUTS = {'exports/customers.csv': 'id,region,name\nC00,north,"Branch, 0"\nC01,south,"Branch, 1"\nC02,west,"Branch, 2"\nC03,north,"Branch, 3"\nC04,south,"Branch, 4"\nC05,west,"Branch, 5"\nC06,north,"Branch, 6"\nC07,south,"Branch, 7"\nC08,west,"Branch, 8"\nC09,north,"Branch, 9"\nC10,south,"Branch, 10"\nC11,west,"Branch, 11"\nC12,north,"Branch, 12"\nC13,south,"Branch, 13"\nC14,west,"Branch, 14"\nC15,north,"Branch, 15"\nC16,south,"Branch, 16"\nC17,west,"Branch, 17"\nC18,north,"Branch, 18"\nC19,south,"Branch, 19"\nC20,west,"Branch, 20"\nC21,north,"Branch, 21"\nC22,south,"Branch, 22"\nC23,west,"Branch, 23"\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/split_customers.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    def verify(src):
        before=get(src);rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(before)))
        run(src,'regional desks')
        for group in ['north','south','other']:
            text=get('regional desks/'+group+'.csv')
            expected=[r for r in rows if (r['region'] if r['region'] in ('north','south') else 'other')==group]
            assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))) == ['id', 'region', 'name']
            assert '\r' not in text
            assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text))) == expected
        assert get(src)==before and get('regional desks/notes.txt')=='retain\n'
    put('regional desks/notes.txt','retain\n');verify('exports/customers.csv')
    put('other export.csv','id,region,name\nA,NORTH,"A, B"\nB,south,"Quote ""Q"""\nC,north,Desk\n')
    verify('other export.csv')
    put('other export.csv','id,region,name\n');verify('other export.csv')
    assert set(tree('regional desks')) == {'north.csv','south.csv','other.csv','notes.txt'}
